form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Rubio introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions

form.official-title: To amend the Higher Education Act of 1965 to provide student loan deferment for victims of terrorist attacks.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Terrorism Survivors Student Loan Deferment Act.

section.header: Student loan deferment for victims of terrorist attacks

subsection.header: Terms of federally insured student loans
subsection.text: Section 427(a)(2)(C) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1077(a)(2)(C)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in clause (iii), by striking or after the semicolon;
in clause (iv), by striking the period at the end and inserting ; or; and
by adding at the end the following:

clause.text: not in excess of 1 year due to the borrower being a victim of a terrorist attack;

subsection.text: Section 428(b) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1078(b)) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in clause (iv), by striking or after the semicolon;
in clause (v), by inserting or after the semicolon; and
by adding at the end the following:

clause.text: not in excess of 1 year due to the borrower being a victim of a terrorist attack as described in paragraph (10);

paragraph.text: by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.header: Deferment for victims of terrorist attacks
paragraph.text: For purposes of deferment under paragraph (1)(M)(vi), a victim of a terrorist attack is an individual who is designated as a victim of a terrorist attack by the head of the Federal agency that is handling the investigation of the attack.

subsection.text: Section 455 of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1087e) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (e)(7)(B)(i), by inserting or due to the borrower being a victim of a terrorist attack after section 435(o); and

clause.text: in subparagraph (C), by striking clause (i) or (ii); or and inserting clause (i) or (ii);;
in subparagraph (D), by striking the period at the end and inserting ; or; and
by adding at the end the following:

subparagraph.text: not in excess of 1 year due to the borrower being a victim of a terrorist attack as described in paragraph (6).
by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.header: Deferment for victims of terrorist attacks
paragraph.text: For purposes of deferment under paragraph (2)(E), a victim of a terrorist attack is an individual who is designated as a victim of a terrorist attack by the head of the Federal agency that is handling the investigation of the attack.

subsection.text: Section 464(c)(2) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1087dd(c)(2)) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in clause (v), by striking or after the semicolon;
in clause (vi), by inserting or after the semicolon; and
by inserting after clause (vi) the following:

clause.text: not in excess of 1 year due to the borrower being a victim of a terrorist attack as described in subparagraph (D);

paragraph.text: by adding at the end the following:

subparagraph.text: For purposes of deferment under subparagraph (A)(vii), a victim of a terrorist attack is an individual who is designated as a victim of a terrorist attack by the head of the Federal agency that is handling the investigation of the attack.

subsection.text: The head of the Federal agency that is handling the investigation of a terrorist attack, or has handled the investigation of a terrorist attack, shall designate the individuals who are victims of such terrorist attack.
The Secretary of Education shall establish anti-fraud protections in carrying out the amendments made by this Act.
